business_summary: Konaka Co.,Ltd. operates specialty stores in Japan. It operates through three segments: Fashion Business, Food Service Business, and Education Business. The company plans, manufactures, and sells men's and women's clothing and fashion accessories. It also provides suits, formal wear, easy-to-order items, coats, innerwear, jackets, bottoms, outerwear, casual wear, shirts, ties, underwear, shoes, bags, and jewelry under the Konaka, SUIT SELECT, DIFFERENCE, Futata, FUTATA THE FLAG, Samantha Thavasa, SAMANTHAVEGA, Samantha Thavasa Petit Choice, Samantha Tiara, SAMANTHA SILVA, KINGZ, Samantha Thavasa GOLF, & chouette, and FIT HOUSE brands. In addition, the company operates restaurants under the Katsuya, Tonkatsu Specialty Restaurant Katsuya, Fried Chicken Specialty Restaurant Karayama, Popular Restaurant Handaya, Shu-La-Lou, Copel, and En names; education business under the Kids Duo Kids Duo International name; and general fashion shop under the Fit House name. Further, it is involved in management of clothing repair shops; provision of manufacturing, tailoring, and cleaning services, as well as clothing repair; management of recycle shops; wholesale of used clothing; and management of SUIT SELECT shop. Konaka Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1952 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.
